laws.text: I Am [YAHWAH] Thy Power, Who Brought Thee Out Of Egypt.
Thou Shalt Have No Other Powers Before Me.
[YAHWAH] Our Power Is One Master.
Love [YAHWAH] Thy Power With All Thy Heart, Soul, And Might.
Fear [YAHWAH] Thy Power, Serve Him, And Cleave To Him.
Be Holy, For I [YAHWAH] Am Holy.
Do Not Profane My Holy Name.
Do Not Destroy Anything Connected To My Name.
Hearken Onto The Prophet Whom [YAHWAH] Thy Power Shall Raise Up.
Do Not Test [YAHWAH] Thy Power.
Keep [YAHWAH]'s Commandments And Walk In His Ways.
Fear [YAHWAH] And Cleave To Him.
Love Thy Neighbor As Thyself.
Love Ye Therefore The Stranger: For Ye Were Strangers In The Land Of Egypt.
Thou Shalt Not Hate Thy Brother In Thine Heart.
Thou Shalt In Any Wise Rebuke Thy Neighbour, And Not Suffer Sin Upon Him.
Thou Shalt Neither Vex A Stranger, Nor Oppress Him: For Ye Were Strangers In The Land Of Egypt.
Thou Shalt Not Go Up And Down As A Talebearer Among Thy People.
Thou Shalt Not Avenge, Nor Bear Any Grudge Against The Children Of Thy People.
And There Shall Cleave Nought Of The Cursed Thing To Thine Hand.
Stand Up In The Presence Of The Elderly, And Show Respect For The Aged. Fear Your Power. I Am [YAHWAH].
Turn Ye Not Unto Idols, Nor Make To Yourselves Molten Powers.
Ye Shall Make Fringes In The Borders Of Your Garments, And Put Upon The Fringe A Ribband Of Blue, That Ye Remember And Do All My Commandments.
That Ye Seek Not After Your Own Heart And Your Own Eyes, After Which Ye Use To Go A Whoring.
Thou Shalt Not Revile The Powers, Nor Curse The Ruler Of Thy People.
Thou Shalt Not Make Unto Thee Any Graven Image.
Thou Shalt Not Bow Down Thyself To Them, Nor Serve Them.
Thou Shalt Make No Covenant With Them, Nor With Their Powers.
Thou Shalt Surely Smite The Inhabitants Of That City... And Burn With Fire The City.
Certain Men... Saying, Let Us Go And Serve Other Powers.—Thou Shalt Not Consent Unto Him, Nor Hearken Unto Him.
